item.title: Who actually runs Iran right now? The key power players as Trump claims talks to 'top' official
item.summary: Analysts say the Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps has emerged as Iran's dominant force, with Supreme Leader Mojtaba Khamenei's grip on power reportedly uncertain after recent strikes.

item.title: Trump energy czar says Iran conflict gas spike is ‘temporary blip’ as drilling push ramps up
item.summary: Despite the ongoing conflict in Iran, President Donald Trump’s “energy czar" Doug Burgum is confident the “temporary blip up" in gas and energy prices will come back down very soon.

item.title: US military sends drones, alongside 200 troops, to Nigeria amid fears of renewed Boko Haram insurgency
item.summary: The U.S. military deployed MQ-9 Reaper drones to Nigeria for intelligence-gathering and training as the African country is grappling with a security crisis.

item.title: Mattis identifies 'problem' if US declares victory over Iran now
item.summary: The U.S. is in a "tough spot" because Iran would claim control of the Strait of Hormuz if the war stopped now, former Defense Secretary Jim Mattis said.

item.title: Trump touts ‘massive’ Iran ‘present’ linked to Strait of Hormuz as deal talks heat up
item.summary: President Donald Trump said Iran gave the U.S. a 'significant' oil and gas gift tied to the Strait of Hormuz, saying Iran is ready to make a deal on nuclear weapons.

item.title: Former CIA director John Brennan tells MS NOW he believes Iran over President Trump
item.summary: Former CIA Director John Brennan said Monday he believed the Iranian regime over Donald Trump, claiming Trump cannot acknowledge truth when he's "slapped in the face with it."

item.title: Chicago mayor asked about city's immigration policies after illegal immigrant allegedly killed college student
item.summary: Jose Medina, released into the U.S. under Biden after a 2023 border apprehension, allegedly killed Sheridan Gorman, 18, reigniting immigration debate.

item.title: Trump admin says SJSU now faces 'impending enforcement' for transgender volleyball scandal conflict
item.summary: President Donald Trump's Department of Education is cracking down on San Jose State University amid an ongoing Title IX conflict over a transgender former volleyball player.

item.title: King Charles to address Congress in historic first state visit to Washington
item.summary: King Charles will address Congress next month in his first state visit. The trip follows Trump’s Windsor Castle dinner and Speaker Johnson’s UK address.

item.title: Newsom's 'American Psycho' comparison to himself backfires in attempt to lampoon Trump
item.summary: California Gov. Gavin Newsom drew mockery after comparing himself to "American Psycho" character Patrick Bateman in an apparent parody of President Trump's Elvis post.
